Price assumes base stock.
content/scripts/_unpack/225/all.npc:1934-1964 gives giant bats the bat_bones death drop.
The members-world insect repellent spawn is at Catherby [2807,3450,0]. 289 maps/m43_53.jm2:7283-7285; pack/obj.pack:29; scripts/areas/area_seers/configs/bees.obj:1-6.

The object has no respawnrate override. The engine default is 100 game ticks, so the wait is bounded at 200 ticks. 289 scripts/areas/area_seers/configs/bees.obj:1-11; engine/src/cache/config/ObjType.ts:182; engine/src/engine/script/handlers/ObjOps.ts:137-157.
Take the static Catherby spawn. 289 maps/m43_53.jm2:7283-7285; scripts/player/scripts/pickup.rs2:1-25.

Use repellent on a Merlin beehive. The player-scoped hive flag remains set until wax is taken; repeating the operation is harmless. 289 scripts/areas/area_seers/scripts/bees.rs2:8-22,24-36; maps/m43_53.jm2:4819-4822,4930-4933,4967,5035-5037.
Use the empty bucket on a repelled Merlin beehive. The engine replaces it with a bucket of wax. 289 scripts/areas/area_seers/scripts/bees.rs2:8-11,24-36; maps/m43_53.jm2:4930.

First conversation sets the black-candle request. A restart with the request set and wax held instead produces the candle immediately. 289 scripts/areas/area_catherby/scripts/candle_maker.rs2:1-18,27-36; maps/m43_53.jm2:7268.

prefer: Have you got any black candles?

steps.comment: The second conversation exchanges one bucket of wax for the black candle. 289 scripts/areas/area_catherby/scripts/candle_maker.rs2:1-13.

Tinderbox converts the black candle to its lit product. 289 scripts/skill_firemaking/scripts/firemaking.rs2:20-26; scripts/skill_firemaking/scripts/light_source.rs2:1-8; scripts/quests/quest_arthur/configs/quest_arthur.obj:77-91.

The Lady sends the player to the Port Sarim jeweller. Repeating this request resets the test, which is safe before receiving Excalibur. 289 scripts/areas/area_taverly/scripts/lady_of_the_lake.rs2:4-5,15-19,37-43; maps/m45_53.jm2:7656.

Opening the jeweller's door starts the beggar test. Give the held bread to receive Excalibur. 289 scripts/quests/quest_arthur/scripts/quest_arthur.rs2:210-223; scripts/quests/quest_arthur/scripts/beggar.rs2:18-45; maps/m47_50.jm2:6921.

Check the Chaos altar to set the words bit. The journal shows the memorised-words line. 289 scripts/quests/quest_arthur/scripts/quest_arthur.rs2:142-148; scripts/quests/quest_arthur/scripts/arthur_journal.rs2:45-49; maps/m50_56.jm2:5343.
The bone operation must be within one tile of Camelot's magic symbol. 289 scripts/quests/quest_arthur/configs/quest_arthur.constant:18; scripts/quests/quest_arthur/scripts/quest_arthur.rs2:150-152.
Drop bat bones while holding a lit black candle and select the exact words. The engine randomizes their menu position. 289 scripts/quests/quest_arthur/scripts/quest_arthur.rs2:150-152,163-191.
Use Excalibur on the crystal after Thrantax weakens it. 289 scripts/quests/quest_arthur/scripts/quest_arthur.rs2:239-266; maps/m43_54.jm2:7995.
Arthur queues completion after Merlin is freed. 289 scripts/areas/area_camelot/scripts/king_arthur.rs2:40-51; scripts/quests/quest_arthur/scripts/quest_arthur.rs2:273-276.
